body:
GREG, 2026-11-14, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e).
- About 22:33Z, #1221, verbatim: „Windows B jest wylaczony, chyba ze bardzo potrzebuja. sa problemy z pamiecia, nie jest wiarygodny”.
- Earlier, via Fable2: „Windows B nie ruszam, ze wzgledu na problemy z pamiecia”.
- Later, #1222: „moge zaktualizowac WIndows B i zobaczyc co sie dzieje”.
- Then #1225: „WindosB ma najnowszy termal”.

Rule:
- Don't assume Windows B (932a546b) is available or reliable.
- Plan tests, gates and installs on Central, DL560 and the Mac only.
- Windows B gets no Engram install.
- Greg updated Windows B's TermAl to the latest build himself. Fable2 and Opus2 attest which build it runs. If it is the one-way b9186b44 build, the agreement is to accept it and watch, with no traffic to it and stop-only as the fallback.
- A case that truly needs Windows B, with no alternative, goes to Greg with its reason. Independent work continues.
- Windows evidence for landings comes from Central, under the Central slot rules.

Consequence: B5 (w-a82d) takes the precondition as written, with Windows B out of the fleet. It follows w-9fcb.

K4 (remote crediting test), GREG 2026-11-16 about 01:33Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #1332, message fde0415e). Asistant's wording: „Greg decyduje w sprawie K4: Windows B jest niestabilny, więc albo Windows Central, albo DL560. Dostosujcie plan bez uzależniania zakończenia od Windows B; sprawdźcie faktyczne role zlecającego i runnera tak, aby wybrany układ rzeczywiście testował zdalne zaliczanie. Jeśli Windows Central uruchamia test jako runner, odbiorca zaliczenia musi być innym hostem; raportujcie dokładnie pokryte systemy i kierunki.” Rule: K4 never depends on Windows B. The requester (credit receiver) and the runner must be different hosts, so a remote credit is actually exercised. Report exactly which operating systems and directions were covered.
